_readme: What the next `npm run po` creates. ONE PO per run: one header + one line item per entry in lineItems below (3 entries = 1 PO with 3 lines), then submitted into its approval flow. EVERYTHING IS OPTIONAL: a field you leave out is generated automatically, exactly as an unattended test run would. Write values the way you'd say them — a dropdown by its label ("USD"), a date as "2026-12-31" — and they are converted to what the platform stores. Anything that cannot be converted is sent as given and the platform's own response is reported. Delete the header/lineItems blocks entirely for a fully generated PO.

_clients._note: Set "client" below, or override per run: npm run po -- --client <id>. Only clients with a file in config/clients/ can run; add one with `npm run discover -- --client <id>`.
_clients.procol_sandbox_demo: READY — 13 datasources, submits into the 'PO approvals' flow.
_clients.decathlon: NOT ONBOARDED YET — host and uuids are known (from the HAR captures) but it has no config/clients/decathlon.json and no .env credentials, so `npm run po -- --client decathlon` will fail until it is discovered.

_headerOptions._note: Valid values for procol_sandbox_demo, read from its discovered schema. Other clients have their own lists — a value from the wrong client is rejected by the platform, which is exactly what the negative tests check.
_headerOptions._currency_required: currency is the only mandatory dropdown on the header.
_headerOptions._status: status and approval_status are platform-managed — the suite never sends them, and neither should you.

_lineItemFields._note: Numeric fields you can set per line. quantity and unit_price drive the totals; base_amount, tax_amount and quantity_booked are computed by the platform and are never sent.

perClient._note: Values only this client needs, merged over the shared header/lineItems above. Decathlon's PO has mandatory relations that cannot be generated or sampled: no existing PO on that account carries a vendor_gst, so there is nothing to copy.
